# DeepSeek Uncensored — RouterHub

> DeepSeek Uncensored model guide: API access, client setup, evaluation notes and a 35-file research prompt collection. One RouterHub key also covers GPT, Claude, GLM, Qwen and Grok. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible; pay per token.

## Key facts

- Primary keyword: DeepSeek Uncensored.
- Covers DeepSeek uncensored and abliterated model variants where available.
- The repository bundles 35 research prompt files in `jailbreaks/`.
- API: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible where supported by the selected catalogue entry.
- Billing: prepaid, pay per token, no subscription.
- Model IDs and variant availability belong to the RouterHub dashboard and model catalogue.
- Reduced refusal behavior is not a guarantee; evaluate the exact model ID.
